features.featureTitle: Refine the authenticated loading flow so the UI never shows the Events/Tasks views (or their query-driven error states) until all prerequisites are satisfied: (1) Internet Identity is authenticated, (2) the backend actor is ready, (3) the user profile has been fetched (and profile setup completed if needed), and (4) the encryption session is unlocked. When these prerequisites are not yet satisfied, show a clear, non-destructive loading state (English text) instead of rendering query error alerts.

Adjust React Query behavior for events/tasks fetching so that, after a logout/login cycle (including logging back in as the same principal) and subsequent unlock, the events and tasks queries reliably refetch and render fresh decrypted data without requiring a manual page refresh or the user pressing “Retry”. This should be achieved by refining the query enable/refetch conditions and/or invalidation strategy tied to actor readiness and unlock state (without editing files in frontend immutablePaths).
